name: aws-to-gcp
description: Convert AWS workloads to Google Cloud (GCP). Paste AWS Terraform, CloudFormation, config, or SDK code in any Claude app and get the GCP version, or plan and run a full migration of compute, serverless, big data, and storage in Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Convert AWS workloads to Google Cloud (GCP). Paste AWS Terraform, CloudFormation, config, or SDK code in any Claude app and get the GCP version, or plan and run a full migration of compute, serverless, big data, and storage in Claude Code. Keeps resumable migration state in .migration/, inventories AWS resources before changing anything, and checks each migrated piece for parity with the original.
defaultPrompt: Convert this AWS Terraform to GCP
Plan a migration of this AWS project to GCP
